title: Coordination Seam Event v1
description: Schema-governed contract seam event. Records audit-discovered gaps in contract surfaces: missing schemas, missing producers/consumers, validator theater, fake-green tests, and unverifiable release blockers. Content-light: no raw file paths or contents.

event_id.description: Deterministic event ID derived from content hash.

contract_family_id.description: Identifier of the contract family (e.g., ci_cd, mcp, acp, sdk).

proof_chain_status.description: Status of the proof chain for this contract surface.

fake_green_risk.description: Risk that enforcement tests are fake-green (testing text, not evidence).

affected_file_hashes.description: SHA256 hashes of affected file paths (salted, content-light).

evidence_file_hashes.description: SHA256 hashes of evidence file paths.

schema_file_hashes.description: SHA256 hashes of schema file paths.

implementation_file_hashes.description: SHA256 hashes of implementation file paths.

validator_file_hashes.description: SHA256 hashes of validator file paths.

test_file_hashes.description: SHA256 hashes of test file paths.

trace_fields_observed.description: Trace/correlation fields present at this contract surface.

trace_fields_missing.description: Trace/correlation fields absent from this contract surface.

telemetry_redaction_implications.description: Description of telemetry or redaction implications of this seam.

concurrency_implications.description: Description of concurrency or mutation authority implications.

recommended_next_action.description: Recommended next action to close this seam.

detected_by.description: Identifier of the audit or scanner that detected this seam.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event generation.
